text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, mostly crisp green leaves (light and mid-green, some ruffled lettuce-like pieces) with several dark reddish-purple leaves interspersed; leaves are fresh, moist, and hold their shape, spanning most of the bowl's upper and left portion, roughly 15 cm across and 3 cm deep when piled | 120
ITEM 2 | Shredded orange carrot, thin matchstick strands about 4-5 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, bright orange with slightly glossy, moist surface, scattered across the lower-right and center of the bowl among the greens | 45
ITEM 3 | Shredded red cabbage, thin purple-violet strands about 3-5 cm long, slightly translucent edges, crisp and moist, clustered in the lower-center of the bowl alongside the carrot and white shreds | 15
ITEM 4 | Thinly sliced white-to-pale-green onion or cabbage-like shreds, translucent white strands about 3-4 cm long, moist and limp, sitting in a small cluster in the lower-center among the purple and orange shreds | 8
